description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Fit adult man with broad shoulders and tapered waist. Dark brown-black hair swept upward and back with a side part. Black aviator sunglasses. Narrow face and VERY DISTINCT healed jagged Glasgow-smile scars extending from BOTH mouth corners across the cheeks, with short perpendicular stitch-like scar marks. Closed-mouth sinister slight smile. This is scar tissue, not a moustache or beard. Black tailored suit, white shirt, neat black tie. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 214-222px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo. Match reference native body height, crown about y30 and soles y250. Mouth scars form a long jagged horizontal line from each lip corner across cheek, crossed by short vertical stitches, no beard.

style_image.usage_description: Use only pixel rendering, native standing scale and FRONT pose. Do not copy identity. Target cheek scars at BOTH mouth corners must be visible.
